pictures.inspected: Frontal autumn view: four exposed timber posts, raised open square platform, steep straight stair/handrails, vertical rails and a shallow green pyramid roof. Nearby mature tree is separate, not part of the structure.

pictures.author: Котельников
pictures.inspected: Closer oblique: green four-sided pyramidal roof over exposed timber frame, open platform/vertical balusters, genuinely open undercroft on four posts, narrow steep stair with individual treads and two handrails. Brown/gray weathered timber. Tree canopy conceals some rear inventory.

currentRoundInspection.scope: Complete small timber tower gazebo: four tall exposed posts, open raised square platform, steep stair with separate treads/stringers/handrails, vertical platform balusters with a real stair entry, bracing and green pyramidal sheet-metal roof with underside rafters. Shared wood_plain and metal_standing_seam graphs, four authored LODs and no private texture atlas, copied photograph pixels or attached tree geometry. Hidden joinery and exact scale remain original photo-led approximations.
